regions.today: A dry start for many with isolated showers and occasional brighter spells. Turning wet for the afternoon and evening with persistent rain spreading from the west, turning heavy at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees, with moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Rain will continue to clear southeastwards with isolated showers following in behind. Clear spells will develop at times too. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 14 degrees in light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Dry to start, mostly with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Throughout the day, isolated showers will feed in from the west, but in general, it is looking like a mostly dry day with good sunshine. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in moderate to fresh westerly winds.
